description: Add a character to the scene from a card file. 'card' must come from studio_list_character_cards — its 'female/' or 'male/' prefix is what selects which character is created. Position, orientation and scale are optional (scene scale is not metres — read an existing object's transform first). WARNING: Studio NEO V2 has no undo command for adding a character, so this clears Studio's undo stack, exactly like the Add menu does.

sex.description: only needed when 'card' is an absolute path outside UserData/chara

output.description: same shape as one entry of studio_list_objects, with kind='character'
